query:
INSERT INTO productVariants (productId, printfulVariantId, name, retailPrice, currency, size, color, inStock) 
SELECT 
  (SELECT id FROM products WHERE name = 'The Flag Bearer Tee - White' LIMIT 1),
  20000 + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (),
  CONCAT('White / ', size),
  2500 + (CASE size WHEN 'S' THEN 0 WHEN 'M' THEN 0 WHEN 'L' THEN 0 WHEN 'XL' THEN 100 WHEN '2XL' THEN 200 WHEN '3XL' THEN 300 END),
  'USD',
  size,
  'White',
  1
FROM (SELECT 'S' as size UNION SELECT 'M' UNION SELECT 'L' UNION SELECT 'XL' UNION SELECT '2XL' UNION SELECT '3XL') sizes;
